scope: Construct a paid fixed-tape frontend from the actual PR4174 Plan/Placement binary field-layout description to PR4990's seven protected unary descriptors (G,H,K,Y,J0,J1,B), for one two-target full-guard color subbatch of CRT.md section4. Derive current target positions through the actual three exchanges, prove membership of both targets in one valid color and their complete guard separation, and transport, preserve and retire descriptors around the existing producer/scanner call. Implement source control and descriptor arithmetic rather than accepting host-computed J0/J1. The actual selector must identify a real two-target subbatch before implementing the adapter; treat larger target batches and last-K exceptions as separate, explicitly retained paths.
changed_premise: PR4990 starts with seven already-protected unary words and explicitly requests their actual-caller producer. PR4174 computes placement/fragment coordinates in Python and does not price descriptor production. Supply the missing representation boundary and actual caller binding, not another mask, key producer, repair theorem or arbitrary two-target toy.
first_fixture: Take the first actual PR4174 production layout/color with exactly two selected target bits, including a target whose axis is split by a placement cut. Keep the production layout symbolic and execute its small descriptor tapes only; verify mapped positions with an independent interval-exchange oracle. Then derive a reduced literal geometry preserving the same cut/order pattern and join the unchanged producer and scanner. The existing (1,2,5,12,1,7,0) mask is only a consumer calibration, not evidence of actual selection. Stop before a full payload census at production size.
success: A quantified source-bound descriptor algorithm for all admitted two-target full-guard subbatches, fixed finite tape/alphabet count, explicit setup/transport/return/erasure bill in binary input length and L, and a proof that that bill is absorbed once per complete target fiber under CRT.md's L,R,V premises. Full input/head restoration and correct union-of-failures stencil, with arbitrary dirty borrowed fields. Explicit separation of descriptor cost from the existing scanner and opaque-record repair models.
stop: Stop if no real two-target color subbatch can be identified, if transported target independence/guard hypotheses fail, or if setup repeats per record and exceeds the caller allowance. Preserve a concrete source incompatibility instead of inventing a caller. Do not broaden to variable target count, last-K implementation, payload placement or complete binary repair.
bounds: Only symbolic production layout and small descriptor tapes. No payload enumeration, child coordinate values, full native replay, Lean, Docker or builds.
inherited_obligations: Actual two-target same-color full-guard selection including a split axis before adapter construction
All binary geometry arithmetic and descriptor lifecycle charged
Larger target sets and last-K exceptions remain separate paths
